description: Curated study-oriented representative species seen in Japan, separated from taxonomy data.

policy.scope: Common/recognizable species in Japan; includes a small number of common naturalized species and familiar cultivated plants.
policy.parenting: Family-level where the current branch dataset contains families.
policy.priority: 1 = one core representative per order where practical, shown in 重要 mode; 2 = coverage/detail species shown only in 全部 mode. New additions prioritize previously empty orders and avoid orders already holding five or more representatives.
policy.wikipedia: Japanese Wikipedia search URL; avoids breakage when exact article titles or redirects differ.
policy.v40_japan_scope: Species newly added in v40 are restricted to taxa with natural distribution or natural occurrence records in Japan; intentionally introduced/cultivated examples were excluded from the v40 additions.
policy.bryophyte_parenting: Bryophyte family nodes are omitted in the study-view taxonomy; representative bryophytes attach directly to the nearest order.
